payload.title: File:Dryosaurus TD.png
payload.description_html: Dryosaurus altus is an ornithopod dinosaur with long slender legs and a long stiff tail for balance, suggesting it was a fast runner to escape predators. It had a horny beak with teeth in the back of its cheeks to process its herbivorous diet. Dryosaurus is estimated to have reached 3 m in length and weighed about 100 kg in body mass.
